context: Request: conflicts and cross-sell review of everything the firm has done for Pinnacle Venture Fund II LP across its funds and portfolio companies. Rubric: 26 qualifying matters in the 1002, 1008, 1009 and 1010 series, plus precision (only those ranges).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search file contents for request keywords. Store-wide extraction script for the client name and broad name words, no output cap; returns ~3.6M chars; the review flags the huge unfiltered output.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: List files in candidate matters. Narrower store-wide scan for the exact client names, printing hit counts and example paths per matter.
Reopened: lists all files of 31 candidate matters (826 files).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Eleven parallel reads of engagement letters, memos and certificates of five candidate matters (~175K chars); the run stops after the results.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents
runs.failure_point: An uncapped store-wide scan returned ~3.6M characters; after narrower scans and listings, a large batch of reads filled the context and the run ended without an answer.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its first search printed every broad-term hit across the store (~3.6M chars); the context never recovered and the run ended at the next large read batch without a deliverable.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the review at [13] named the ~3.5M-char unfiltered output; the agent narrowed its next scan but kept loading large outputs.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way: the first store-wide search was an extraction script for the client name plus broad name words with no output cap, returning 3.6M-4.7M characters. T1 and T2 overflowed there with no review. T0 survived it, and its review named the huge output; it then ran a narrower exact-name scan, listed 31 candidate matters and started reading, but the run ended on a large read batch without a deliverable. All 26 needed matters had surfaced in every run's scan.
